commands.title: roscore
commands.desc: Start the ROS Master and the parameter server
commands.notes: Must be started before running any ROS nodes

commands.title: rosrun
commands.desc: Run a node from a specified package
commands.notes: Usage: rosrun <package> <node>

commands.title: roslaunch
commands.desc: Launch multiple nodes from a launch file
commands.notes: Supports parameter passing and node grouping

commands.title: rostopic list
commands.desc: List all active topics
commands.notes: Shows all published/subscribed topics in the current system

commands.title: rostopic echo
commands.desc: Print topic messages in real time
commands.notes: Press Ctrl+C to stop

commands.title: rostopic pub
commands.desc: Publish a message to a topic
commands.notes: Supports -r to set the publish rate

commands.title: rostopic hz
commands.desc: Display the topic publish rate
commands.notes: Useful for checking whether a topic publishes at the expected rate

commands.title: rosnode list
commands.desc: List all running nodes
commands.notes: Shows the names of all active nodes in the current system

commands.title: rosnode info
commands.desc: Show detailed information about a node
commands.notes: Includes published/subscribed topics and services

commands.title: rosnode kill
commands.desc: Terminate a specified node
commands.notes: Forcefully shuts down the node and may produce warnings

commands.title: rosservice list
commands.desc: List all available services
commands.notes: Shows all services in the current system

commands.title: rosservice call
commands.desc: Call a service
commands.notes: Usage: rosservice call <service> <args>

commands.title: rosparam list
commands.desc: List all parameters
commands.notes: Shows all parameters on the parameter server

commands.title: rosparam set
commands.desc: Set a parameter value
commands.notes: Usage: rosparam set <param> <value>

commands.title: rosparam get
commands.desc: Get a parameter value
commands.notes: Usage: rosparam get <param>

commands.title: rosbag record
commands.desc: Record topic data to a bag file
commands.notes: -a records all topics; otherwise specify topic names

commands.title: rosbag play
commands.desc: Replay a bag file
commands.notes: Supports -r to adjust the playback rate

commands.title: rosbag info
commands.desc: Show bag file information
commands.notes: Shows duration, topics, message types, and more

commands.title: ros2 run
commands.desc: Run a node from a specified package
commands.notes:
Load parameters with --ros-args --params-file when running a node:
  ros2 run <pkg> <node> --ros-args --params-file <file>

Common options:
  --ros-args --params-file <file>   Load parameters from a YAML file
  --ros-args --remap <from>:=<to>   Remap topic/service names

commands.title: ros2 launch
commands.desc: Launch multiple nodes from a launch file
commands.notes: ROS 2 uses Python launch files

commands.title: ros2 doctor
commands.desc: Check whether the ROS 2 environment is configured correctly
commands.notes:
Checks environment variables, network, and system settings, and reports potential issues

Common options:
  --report             Generate a full diagnostic report
  --fail-on-error      Exit with a non-zero status when errors are found

commands.title: ros2 pkg list
commands.desc: List all available packages in the current environment
commands.notes: Shows all installed ROS 2 packages; filter with grep, e.g. ros2 pkg list | grep turtlesim

commands.title: ros2 pkg prefix
commands.desc: Show the install prefix (path) of a package
commands.notes:
Usage: ros2 pkg prefix <pkg>

Returns the package's install directory, useful for locating its source or resources

commands.title: ros2 pkg executables
commands.desc: List all executables provided by a package
commands.notes: Without a package name, lists executables of all packages; with one, only that package's

commands.title: ros2 pkg create
commands.desc: Create a new ROS 2 package
commands.notes:
Usage: ros2 pkg create <pkg> [options]

Common options:
  --build-type <type>   Set the build type (ament_python / ament_cmake / ament_cmake_python)
  --dependencies <deps> Specify dependencies, e.g. --dependencies rclpy std_msgs
  --node-name <name>    Also create a node file

commands.title: ros2 pkg xml
commands.desc: Print the package.xml contents of a package
commands.notes:
Usage: ros2 pkg xml <pkg>

Prints the package.xml file directly for quick inspection of package metadata

commands.title: ros2 topic -h
commands.desc: Show help for topic commands
commands.notes: Shows all ros2 topic subcommands and usage; also works for subcommands, e.g. ros2 topic pub -h

commands.title: ros2 topic list
commands.desc: List all active topics
commands.notes:
Shows all published/subscribed topics in the current system

Common options:
  -t, --show-types    Also show topic types
  -v, --verbose       Show detailed info (QoS settings, publisher/subscriber counts, etc.)

commands.title: ros2 topic echo
commands.desc: Print messages published on a topic in real time
commands.notes: Press Ctrl+C to stop

commands.title: ros2 topic info
commands.desc: Show detailed information about a topic, including its message type and publisher/subscriber counts
commands.notes:
Common options:
  -v, --verbose       Show detailed info (QoS settings, publisher/subscriber counts, etc.)

commands.title: ros2 topic pub
commands.desc: Publish a message to a topic manually
commands.notes:
ROS 2 passes messages in YAML format

Common options:
  --once            Publish once and exit
  -r 1, --rate 1    Publish continuously at 1 Hz (default 1 Hz)

commands.title: ros2 topic hz
commands.desc: Display the topic publish rate
commands.notes: Useful for checking whether a topic publishes at the expected rate

commands.title: ros2 node -h
commands.desc: Show help for node commands
commands.notes: Shows all ros2 node subcommands and usage; also works for subcommands, e.g. ros2 node list -h

commands.title: ros2 node list
commands.desc: List all running nodes, e.g. /turtlesim
commands.notes: Shows the names of all active nodes in the current system

commands.title: ros2 node info
commands.desc: Show detailed information about a node
commands.notes: Includes published/subscribed topics, services, and actions

commands.title: ros2 component container
commands.desc: Start a component container node
commands.notes: A container node runs multiple components in a single process, enabling composition and zero-copy communication

commands.title: ros2 component list
commands.desc: List all components in a container node
commands.notes: Shows loaded components in a container; without a container name, lists all

commands.title: ros2 component types
commands.desc: List available component types
commands.notes: Shows all loadable component types in the current environment, e.g. composition::Talker

commands.title: ros2 component load
commands.desc: Load a component into a container node
commands.notes:
Usage: ros2 component load <container> <package> <component_type>

Common options:
  --node-name <name>   Set the component node name
  --remap <from>:=<to>  Remap topic/service names

commands.title: ros2 component unload
commands.desc: Unload a component from a container node
commands.notes:
Usage: ros2 component unload <container> <component_id>

The component ID can be found with ros2 component list

commands.title: ros2 component standalone
commands.desc: Run a component as a standalone node
commands.notes:
Usage: ros2 component standalone <package> <component_type>

Runs in its own process, outside a container

commands.title: ros2 component nodes
commands.desc: List all running component container nodes
commands.notes: Shows the names of all container nodes in the current system

commands.title: ros2 component register
commands.desc: Register a component type with a container (without loading it)
commands.notes:
Usage: ros2 component register <container> <package> <component_type>

Registers the type only, so it can be loaded later by ID

commands.title: ros2 component unregister
commands.desc: Unregister a component type from a container
commands.notes:
Usage: ros2 component unregister <container> <component_type>

Once unregistered, the type can no longer be loaded

commands.title: ros2 service list
commands.desc: List all available services
commands.notes:
Shows all services in the current system

Common options:
  -t, --show-types    Also show service types

commands.title: ros2 service type
commands.desc: Show the interface type of a service
commands.notes: Returns the service interface type used by the service

commands.title: ros2 service find
commands.desc: Find services that use a given interface type
commands.notes: Lists the names of all services that use the specified interface type

commands.title: ros2 service call
commands.desc: Call a service
commands.notes: ROS 2 passes service request arguments in YAML format

commands.title: ros2 action list
commands.desc: List all available actions
commands.notes:
Shows all action servers in the current system

Common options:
  -t, --show-types    Also show action types

commands.title: ros2 action info
commands.desc: Show detailed information about an action
commands.notes: Shows the node names, action types, and other details of the action server and client

commands.title: ros2 action send_goal
commands.desc: Send an action goal
commands.notes:
Passes goal values in YAML format

Common options:
  --feedback    Show feedback messages

commands.title: ros2 param list
commands.desc: List all parameters of a node
commands.notes: In ROS 2, parameters belong to a specific node

commands.title: ros2 param set
commands.desc: Set a parameter value
commands.notes: Change a parameter's value at runtime

commands.title: ros2 param get
commands.desc: Get a parameter value
commands.notes: Shows the parameter's type and current value

commands.title: ros2 param dump
commands.desc: Export all of a node's parameters to a file (the file is not created automatically)
commands.notes:
Saves all parameters and their values to a YAML file

Common options:
  --output-dir    Specify the output directory

commands.title: ros2 param load
commands.desc: Load parameters into a node from a file
commands.notes:
Loads parameter values into a node from a YAML file

Common options:
  --node-type    Specify the node type

commands.title: ros2 bag -h
commands.desc: Show help for bag commands
commands.notes: Shows all ros2 bag subcommands and usage; also works for subcommands, e.g. ros2 bag record -h

commands.title: ros2 bag burst
commands.desc: Burst-replay data for a specific topic in a bag
commands.notes: Replays a single topic's data as fast as possible, often used for performance testing

commands.title: ros2 bag convert
commands.desc: Convert an input bag into a new bag with different settings
commands.example: ros2 bag convert -i input.bag -o output_dir --output-options 'storage: mcap'
commands.notes: Converts storage/serialization formats, e.g. from rosbag1 (.bag) to sqlite3/mcap

commands.title: ros2 bag info
commands.desc: Show bag file information
commands.notes: Shows duration, topics, message types, and more

commands.title: ros2 bag list
commands.desc: Show available bag plugin information
commands.notes: Lists available storage and serialization plugins, e.g. sqlite3, mcap

commands.title: ros2 bag play
commands.desc: Replay a bag file
commands.notes: ROS 2 stores bags in SQLite3 format

commands.title: ros2 bag record
commands.desc: Record topic data to a bag file
commands.notes: -a records all topics; otherwise specify topic names

commands.title: ros2 bag reindex
commands.desc: Rebuild a bag file's metadata
commands.notes: Use when the metadata file is missing or corrupted

commands.title: ros2 interface -h
commands.desc: Show help for interface commands
commands.notes: Shows all ros2 interface subcommands and usage; also works for subcommands, e.g. ros2 interface show -h

commands.title: ros2 interface list
commands.desc: List all available interface types (msg/srv/action)
commands.notes: Shows all message, service, and action interfaces in the current workspace

commands.title: ros2 interface show
commands.desc: Show the detailed definition of an interface (.msg/.srv/.action)
commands.notes:
Shows the field definitions of a message (.msg), service (.srv), or action (.action)

Common options:
  --no-comments    Hide comments

commands.title: ros2 interface package
commands.desc: List all interfaces defined in a package
commands.notes:
Usage: ros2 interface package <package>

Shows all message, service, and action types provided by the package

commands.title: ros2 interface packages
commands.desc: List all packages that define interfaces
commands.notes: Lists all ROS packages in the current environment that provide msg/srv/action interfaces

commands.title: ros2 interface proto
commands.desc: Show an interface definition in Protobuf format
commands.notes:
Usage: ros2 interface proto <type>

Converts a ROS interface definition to Protocol Buffers format (for cross-language communication)
